text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Who's gonna take the win today?
I honestly have no clue...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Teio after all? But McQueen is there too, and Rice Shower's had serious momentum lately.

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
"No way, it's gotta be Bourbon!
Her duel with Teio was incredible, right?"

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Reporter
text_block_list.text:
...Everyone has high expectations
for your performance now.

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Reporter
text_block_list.text: Do your best, Mihono Bourbon...!

While the stands were filled with anticipation and excitement—
the waiting room remained quiet.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Master.
Right now, I am feeling "excited."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Just imagining them running across the turf
fills me with even greater anticipation.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Today, without fail... I will seize victory.

As she quietly waited for the start like that,
a visitor arrived before Mihono Bourbon—
(Knock knock)

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I wonder if Miss Bourbon is doing alright right now...?
Rice Shower came by to visit.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Rice realized something... Before, I never felt this strong urge to win...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I just wanted to become a Rice
who makes everyone happy. But before I knew it――

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
While looking up to Miss Bourbon and chasing after her,
I found myself wanting to win...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Wanting to win someday, wanting to overtake them...
that feeling makes Rice so much stronger."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: It's all thanks to Miss Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...I didn't... anything...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
No...
Bourbon-san told me.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: "And so, that's why, before the race... I wanted to say thank you..."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Bourbon-san.

"Looking at Rice Shower bowing her head,
Mihono Bourbon quietly opened her mouth."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...I know that you worked harder than anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I know the strength it takes to get back up, no matter how many times you stumble.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: The Kikuka Sho... That day, born from your fervent desire to "win"—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: "I, too, learned what it means to 'want to win.' Because I learned that, I'm standing here today."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...It's all thanks to Rice-san.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
That is precisely why—I will not hold back today.
I look forward to our match, Rice-san.
Rice Shower firmly grasped Bourbon's outstretched hand in return.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yeah...!
—And so, the curtains rose on the Arima Kinen.
